    # find vertical bars: columns with nonzero runs not part of horizontal bars

    # detect vertical bars from columns where a color appears in >=1 contiguous run of length>=1 below all horizontal activity? Use: column cells whose up/down neighbors same color

        runs=[]
        i=0

                j=i
                while j+1<h and col[j+1]==col[i]: j+=1
                runs.append((col[i],i,j)); i=j+1

                pass
        # simpler: vertical bar = run where at least... just take runs; horizontal-bar rows are those with span>1; skip cells in such rows

            nz=[j for j,x in enumerate(orig[r]) if x!=0]

        for v,a,b in runs:
            if b-a+1>=1 and not any(is_hbar_row(r) and orig[r][c]==v and True for r in range(a,b+1) if is_hbar_row(r)):

        # final: take last run (bottom-most) as the vertical bar

            v,a,b=runs[-1]

                pass
        # implement rule directly: bottom-most run = vertical bar

        v,t,b=runs[-1][0],runs[-1][1],runs[-1][2]
        # rows 0..t-1: nearest horizontal-bar row r>=i whose bar covers column c
